chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Faddal, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Is the prayer in the house of Fatimah (peace be upon her) more virtuous, or in the Rawdah?' He said, 'In the house of Fatimah (peace be upon her).'
ai.seo_question: Where is prayer more virtuous: in the Rawdah or in the house of Fatimah?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) explicitly prioritizes the prayer in the house of Fatimah (AS) over the Rawdah al-Nabawiyya, underscoring the unique spiritual status of the Ahl al-Bayt's dwellings as extensions of divine presence. This distinction reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the sanctity of the Prophet's family, viewing their residences not merely as historical sites but as active loci of barakah and intercession. The hadith thus serves as a foundational text for the practice of ziyarah to Fatimah's shrine in Medina, linking physical proximity to her grave with elevated spiritual reward.
